# Itsallbee

> > A travel blog focused on African destinations, European itineraries, and culturally-inspired travel lifestyle content.

Itsallbee provides practical travel guides, itineraries, and tips with a focus on African travel (Botswana, Zambia, Victoria Falls) and popular European destinations like Italy. The site also features shopping guides for African-inspired fashion and accessories for travelers.

## Key Topics

- African travel
- Botswana
- Italy itineraries
- Florence
- Victoria Falls
- Kasane to Maun transportation
- Budget travel tips
- Safari gateways
- African print fashion
- Kente swimwear
- Border crossing guides
- Packing lists
- Travel promo codes
- Rome and Venice
- Beach vacation style

## Travel Itineraries

- [Touring Italy In 10 Days – The Perfect Rome Florence & Venice Itinerary](https://www.itsallbee.com/itineraries/italy-rome-florence-venice-itinerary): 10-day Italy itinerary covering Rome, Florence, Venice, and Vatican City

## African Travel Guides

- [How To Get From Kasane To Maun In Botswana](https://www.itsallbee.com/travel-tips/kasane-to-maun-botswana): Transportation guide for traveling between Kasane and Maun in Botswana

## Packing Guides

- [Florence Packing List – What To Wear In Florence In Winter](https://www.itsallbee.com/packing-list-guides/what-to-wear-in-florence-packing-list): Winter packing guide for Florence with clothing recommendations

## Travel Shopping & Style

- [Stunning Kente print swimsuits & African Print Swimwear For Your Next Beach Vacation](https://www.itsallbee.com/shopping/kente-print-swimsuits-african-print-swimwear): Shopping guide for Kente and African print swimwear from brands like Ofuure

## Travel Deals & Discounts

- [April Round Up Of The Best Travel Promo Codes & Discounts! – Travel For Less](https://www.itsallbee.com/travel-tips/april-travel-promo-codes-discounts): April travel deals and promo codes for Hotels.com, eDreams, and Trip.com
